Definition: from G4314 and ψαύω (to touch); to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve):--touch.
BiblicalUsage: Prospsauo means to touch, to lay a finger on. It appears once, in Jesus' woe to the lawyers: ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the lawyers' sin was not their law but their finger: they loaded others and never lifted a finger themselves.
